description: A plugin module for processing 'fill in the blank' challenge sections in markdown AST, involving validation, parsing, and HTML conversion.

methods.name: plugin
methods.description: Main function returning the transformer function for processing markdown AST.

methods.name: transformer
methods.description: Processes the AST to extract and validate fill-in-the-blank sections, converting them to HTML.

methods.name: getFillInTheBlank
methods.description: Extracts and constructs fill-in-the-blank data including sentence and blanks with feedback.

methods.name: getBlanks
methods.description: Processes blanks nodes to extract answers and feedback.

methods.name: validateBlanksSectionCount
methods.description: Ensures there is exactly one '--blanks--' section in the fillInTheBlank challenge.
